en: Black-and-white postcard view of a wide outdoor staircase lined with trees and railings, leading up a hill toward colonial-style buildings. A few people stand or walk on the steps. At the top left of the image is printed text reading 'Cabo Verde - S. Thiago - Entrada da Praia'. The overall look suggests an early 20th‑century colonial streetscape at the entrance to the city of Praia on Santiago Island, Cabo Verde.
